Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Does the DNR from Baseball Bat still apply if you put it into play via Disguised Weapon?

Disguised Weapon
Only usable before range is determined. Equip with a weapon from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). As above, but usable before choosing a strike.

Baseball Bat
Melee weapon. Do not replace until after this action.Strike: strength+1 damage. If the action to equip with the Baseball Bat is successful, unlock the acting minion at the end of the turn.

Equipment

Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
What if Baseball Bat blocked and you play Gift of Bellona sup. do you replace card?

Gift of Bellona
a) If this action is blocked, your hand size is one card larger during the resulting combat.

lnf) Only usable when an action to equip with a weapon is successful. Unlock this acting vampire.

Sup) Only usable when an action to equip with a weapon from your hand is blocked. Before combat begins, equip this vampire with the weapon instead of placing it in your ash heap (pay cost as normal). During the first round of this combat, that weapon cannot be used.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> beslin wrote:
> What if Baseball Bat blocked and you play Gift of Bellona sup. do you replace card?
>
No.
The course of the action was:
1/ equip with the Baseball Bat. Do not replace it "until after this action"
2/ the minion is blocked => play Gift of Bellona

Since Gift of Bellona does not end any "Do not replace" clause, you have to wait "until after this action" (Baseball Bat).

The difference is that the Baseball Bat is played in a normal fashion in that scenario so the DNR clause applies as normal.
